island.name: Health & pharmacy
island.description: Describing symptoms, booking a doctor, buying medicine at the pharmacy.

sentences.en: I don't feel well today.
sentences.ro: Nu mă simt bine astăzi.

sentences.en: I have a headache.
sentences.ro: Mă doare capul.
sentences.note: Pain is expressed with "a durea": literally "the head hurts me".

sentences.en: My throat hurts and I have a fever.
sentences.ro: Mă doare gâtul și am febră.

sentences.en: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor.
sentences.ro: Aș vrea să fac o programare la doctor.
sentences.note: "Programare" is the word for a booked appointment.

sentences.en: When can you see me?
sentences.ro: Când mă puteți primi?
sentences.note: Doctors and clinic staff get "dumneavoastră" — hence "puteți".

sentences.en: It started three days ago.
sentences.ro: A început acum trei zile.

sentences.en: I hurt my knee while running.
sentences.ro: M-am lovit la genunchi când alergam.

sentences.en: Do I need a prescription for this?
sentences.ro: Am nevoie de rețetă pentru asta?
sentences.note: "Rețetă" is both a medical prescription and a cooking recipe.

sentences.en: Do you have something for a cough?
sentences.ro: Aveți ceva pentru tuse?

sentences.en: How many times a day do I take it?
sentences.ro: De câte ori pe zi îl iau?

sentences.en: Take one pill after each meal.
sentences.ro: Luați o pastilă după fiecare masă.

sentences.en: I'm not taking any other medicine.
sentences.ro: Nu iau alte medicamente.

sentences.en: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
sentences.ro: Unde e cea mai apropiată farmacie?

sentences.en: Is this pharmacy open at night?
sentences.ro: Farmacia asta e deschisă noaptea?

sentences.en: I feel dizzy when I stand up.
sentences.ro: Am amețeli când mă ridic.

sentences.en: I slept badly, I'm very tired.
sentences.ro: Am dormit prost, sunt foarte obosit.

sentences.en: Is it something serious?
sentences.ro: E ceva grav?

sentences.en: I have to rest for a few days.
sentences.ro: Trebuie să mă odihnesc câteva zile.

sentences.en: I'm feeling better than yesterday.
sentences.ro: Mă simt mai bine decât ieri.

sentences.en: Get well soon!
sentences.ro: Însănătoșire grabnică!
sentences.note: The standard get-well wish; informally people also say "Să te faci bine!".
